notes.title: Development update April 22, 2021
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! Sorry for being silent recently, but we have a new Oddinary TV: dev update! Check the video or read transcript below! 📺

[previewyoutube=g0aIiyDxzT0;full][/previewyoutube]

I’m very excited to share new content, that I have been working on since the previous update. 

As we approaching the release date, I started to work on finalizing the Sand World location. One of the missing pieces was to have polished bosses for all levels in this world. 

Obviously, I started with boss for the second level. We already had a prototype version of this boss to outline the main ideas. And as for each prototype, it requires several iterations of improving and finalizing many things. 

This boss shares visuals with the existing one, but it has a gold finish in comparison to the stainless steel of the first boss. When I was working on a new boss, I came up with an idea to redo the existing horizontal torpedo launcher for both bosses. It’s a minor visual change, but I think it fits better than the previous version of the weapon. 

Next, I’ve started to work on the actual patterns of the boss. Some of them were already good and required small adjustments, like changing weapon delays or movement speed. As a whole Sand World location, this boss is all about explosive weapons. So, it uses bullets, torpedoes, and new types of weapons – mines. 

The biggest change was done to the enrage phase. Briefly, each boss has two phases – normal and enrage. Enrage phase is triggered, when health of the boss drops below 30-40%. Usually, this phase is more intense and has slightly different weapons from the normal phase. 

For this new boss, I have to design a new set of weapons based on the regular phase. I tried to include all types of weapons, but still to make it more dynamic. Overall, I’m quite happy with the result and after checking with Ksenia (our artist), I’m looking forward to do playtesting this boss.

Talking about playtesting. A new build with this boss will be available starting from this Friday. As usual, we are going to use analytics and some questionaries to gather information about play sessions. If you would like to participate, join our Discord server.

notes.title: Development update January 30, 2021
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! New Oddinary TV: dev update has landed on YouTube. Check the video or read transcript below! 📺

[previewyoutube=k07bvpzo8WI;full][/previewyoutube]

Today I want to talk about some general improvements in the game and the first results of playtesting.

As I mentioned before, we received tons of feedback during Steam Game Festival and Indie Arena Booth. Some of the feedback is related to one of the core mechanics of the game — level modifier or how we call it “Weirdonium leaks”.

We have included a bunch of level modifiers in the demo and tried to understand, what’s working well and what’s not. After checking feedback, we decided to redesign some of them and adjust design principles for items, that are still on the paper.

For example, we have level modifier Ricochet. This modifier adds the probability of being deflected to the player’s bullets. Originally, we designed it to make deflected bullets dangerous for the player, not only for enemies. As you expect, this requires changing how the bullet looks like. The bullet should stand out on the screen because it’s different from player’s and enemies’ bullets.

Unfortunately, it is still hard to grasp, what is happening to the deflected bullet.  We decided to take one step back and rethink this level modifier. After some brainstorming, we came up with small adjustments to it. But it makes the level modifier more player-friendly.

The main change is to disable friendly fire for the deflected bullet, so the player couldn’t get damage from it. Since the bullet remains the same, the player shouldn’t try to avoid it as well. I have also adjusted values for speed and how much damage the enemy gets at the first collision.

https://assets.dash-and-dot.com/oh/steam-events/separator.png

As I mentioned in the previous dev update, we started playtesting sessions via Steam. For today we have done two sessions with different focuses and a small group of people. The first build was focused on testing changes in weapons. For more details check the previous video. In the end, it was a great exercise, we received extra feedback, which made weapons even better!

For example, Missiles Launcher is fine-tuned more to improve the look and feel of missiles flight. I’m considering applying similar changes to all rockets in the game.

Right now we are testing already changed and new level modifiers. Test build includes only one level to have a baseline between different play sessions. This helps us to gather analytics and compare how different level modifiers are affecting gameplay. There are three level modifiers available to test, one of them Ricochet.

We are almost at the end of this playtesting session, but we have more changes to verify. We are going to have more playtesting sessions soon!

notes.title: Weapon changes playtesting round
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

As it was mentioned in previous post, we starting playtesting via Steam. Finally, first build is ready for you to play!

For this round we have prepared test build, which is focused on weapons changes. Participants could play same level with old and new version of weapons, to be precise, updated Shotgun and Missiles Launcher. We have embedded analytics to determine some metrics, e.g. how long it takes to beat the level. With your data we will be able to fine tune new weapons. So, expect updates for this build. :) 

To join this round of playtesting, follow simple steps:
1. Join Discord server
2. Send message to Anton on #oddinary-betta-sign-up channel
3. Activate Steam Key

After a while we are going to send short form to gather feedback from you. We are really excited to hear it!

notes.title: Development update January 7, 2021
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! Anton here and I will share recent developments of Oddinary Highway.

Sorry for keeping you without updates for such a long time. 😔 New development update is here, check the video or read update below. 📺

[previewyoutube=AIH2AKeHmm8;full][/previewyoutube]

It took a while since previous update. But this was a matter of focusing on development and addressing some feedback from Steam Games Festival and Indie Arena Booth.

Today I want to talk in details about some core improvements  in the game. But first, let me ask you a simple question. What’s the most important thing in the shoot’em up? Fun to use weapons of course and we have problem with that! There are some weapons that we have been concerned before, but it became more obvious during online showcases.

The first weapon with change is Shotgun. Initially it was designed to be a manual weapon, which wasn’t the best idea in the end. What you get is the weapon, that nobody  wants to use, because you have to constantly smash the fire button. We have been thinking to adjust it by adding automatic mode with smaller fire rate. But making it fully automatic has more sense and that’s what we did now.

There are other weapons that share same mechanic and I will change all of them.

Next, we have made several adjustments to homing missiles. There are multiple problems with this weapon and I will name few of them: 
* First of all, slow fire rate 
* Another point is the slow missiles 
* And sometimes rocket doesn’t reach target which is a big issue for such weapon

All these makes Missiles Launcher not a fun weapon to play with. I have tried to resolve majority of issues and revamped the weapon completely.

New Missiles Launcher features faster fire rate and rockets flight speed. To balance this, damage was decreased for individual missile. Also, I updated homing system and missile tries to reach target instead of orbiting around it. And more parameters were randomized to improve whole look’n’feel of the weapon.

https://assets.dash-and-dot.com/oh/steam-events/separator.png

These are two major changes which we would like to playtest soon. But due to pandemic it’s not possible to do play testing  offline as we did it before. And we got lucky to receive access to Steam Playtest tool. Right now, I’m preparing first build for that, which should be ready by this weekend. And if you want to take part in this playtesting round, drop by our Discord server, you can find link below below.

notes.title: Biweekly update August 6, 2020
notes.notes:
Hello everyone and welcome to Oddinary Highway Biweekly update!

Anton here. In this update I will cover recent developments of Oddinary Highway.

[previewyoutube=_Vy5LasBuGc;full][/previewyoutube]


As you might know, Indie Arena Booth is large booth for indies which runs during Gamescom in Cologne. This year is not exception, but everything happens online. After previous video, Indie Arena Booth has announced its lineup for this year. And Oddinary Highway is part of it!

Showcase will be replaced with special interactive experience where visitors can explore virtual booths of developers. Each developer should prepare his own booth. For majority of the time since previous biweekly update we have been working on the booth for Oddinary Highway. It was quite fun and we are very happy with the final result. Looking forward to seeing you on our virtual booth!

We are preparing something special for the event itself, which is happening on August 27th till August 30th. So don’t miss the chance to play Oddinary Highway again during that time!

https://assets.dash-and-dot.com/oh/steam-events/separator.png

Once booth was more or less done, we switched back to the development. I decided to revise existing boss from Ocean World called Relation Ship. It has several missing animations. And I started with weapons. During work on it, I found quite severe problem how rotation of weapons is done. In the end we had incorrect calculations for initial rotation angle of the weapon. After fixing this issue, I have finalized work on one of the weapons and going to finish other missing animations in upcoming days.

As usual, there are several non-development activities. We have to prepare demo build for Indie Arena Booth and reach out streamers/youtubers ahead of event. But we try to balance it with progress on the game!

notes.title: Biweekly update July 21, 2020
notes.notes:
Hello everyone and welcome to Oddinary Highway Biweekly update!

Anton here. In this update I will cover recent developments of Oddinary Highway.

[previewyoutube=cidAPLVRyO4;full][/previewyoutube]

As I have mentioned in previous video, there is new level modifier in development. This level modifier is affecting default behavior of secondary item crystals.

To remind, player has a secondary item. It could be the drone with machine gun, decoy or another helpful item. Player should collect special crystals to charge the secondary. And when the charge level is 100%, it can be activated. Crystals are dropped from killed enemies and periodically during the boss fight. Once the secondary is used, it is replaced with a new random item.

https://assets.dash-and-dot.com/oh/steam-events/separator.png

And how does the new level modifier change it? Crystals are pulled to the player from particular distance. This helps to collect them easier. Level modifier does opposite. When player moves around, crystals are pushed away from the hover car. Once player is still, original behavior is back. We hope, new level modifier makes gameplay a bit more challenging, but not frustrating.

notes.title: Biweekly update July 9, 2020
notes.notes:
Hello everyone and welcome to Oddinary Highway Biweekly update!

In this update we will cover recent developments of Oddinary Highway.

[previewyoutube=J7Jq98GjEH8;full][/previewyoutube]

After Steam game festival we gathered valuable feedback about the game. It appears that core mechanic is an area for fine tuning. First thing first – player movement. According to feedback, we have quite bad input handling when it comes to movement of the car. To fix this, input processing is updated to use normalized vector from controls input. Check the difference especially for diagonal movement. It’s much more predictable now!

During festival we streamed special version of Oddinary Highway. What’s so special about it? In transition between levels, game picks random modifier for the next level. Instead of this, we made voting for one out of  three modifiers. This is very first draft, that we made fast for the Steam Game Festival and it required some cleanup. So we spent some time improving the code. It’s still simplified voting functionality, which we want to make for the Streamer mode in the full game. You can check it live during one of the future Oddinary TV: Weekend Streams, where we play latest version of the game and working on it.

https://assets.dash-and-dot.com/oh/steam-events/separator.png

Last week, we worked a bit on new visual effects during the stream. One of them is to visualize applied on enemies slowing effect. Visual effect is still WIP and might change in the future, once it’s used in the game systems. Currently, there is slowing bullets drone and new effect will be used together with it. But we plan set of weapons and secondary items with slowing effect. 

Second effect is rough mockup for the new level modifier, which we will introduce to the game soon.

Apart from that, we have been working on organizational things and preparing for something big. We will share more info about that quite soon!
